mof_ops.detail: 36-week T-bill (maturity 2026-09-29, settlement 2026-01-20), planned offer PLN 2-4bn; final offer due 15 Jan 15:00 (outside windows)

Monthly plan: OK0128/WZ0930/PS0131/NZ0331/DS1035/possible IZ & other series, PLN 8-13bn, settlement 26 Jan. Final offer NOT published by 14 Jan (MoF announces 2 days before). 28 Jan also planned 7-12bn.
No switch or buyback auction held or announced 5-14 Jan; January supply plan (31 Dec) states switching auctions are not planned in January; MoF database shows no other wholesale operations 1-14 Jan.

new_series.coupon: floating: compounded POLSTR (POLSTR Indeks Jednopodstawowy), no margin specified in issue letter; rate fixed in arrears for each period
new_series.coupon_freq: semi-annual (25 Mar / 25 Sep; periods per issue letter annex; first period 2025-09-25 to 2026-03-25, interest accrues from 2025-09-25)
new_series.announced: Issue letter (List emisyjny) 157/2025 dated 2025-12-22 (PDF created 2 Jan 2026; web publication time unverified); listed in Jan supply plan 2025-12-31; final 9 Jan offer published 2026-01-07
new_series.first_sale: 9 Jan: 1,255m sold (75m non-comp) vs 2,070m demand at 95.200; nothing in additional sale. Second POLSTR series after NZ0928 (Millennium 12 Jan)

new_series.note: OK0128, PS0130, WZ0930, PS0131, DS1033, DS1035 all had prior sales (Dec 2025 rows in MoF database); FPC0332 existed (BGK sold it in May 2025). No PS1031, DS0436, OK0128-new, WZ0532 or WZ0931 offered in 5-14 Jan.

facts.text: PKO Dziennik 5 Jan: 10Y SPW fell to 5.17% on Fri 2 Jan, 2Y at multi-year lows on Dec CPI below target; expects SPW to keep relative strength this week, EURPLN 4.20-4.22.

Credit Agricole MAKROmapa 5 Jan: in week to 2 Jan IRS 2Y fell 7bp to 3.54, 5Y -6bp to 3.75, 10Y -6bp to 4.18 on lower Dec CPI; market prices three incomplete cuts by end-2026; Venezuela neutral for PLN/POLGBs.

PAP morning: PKO expects domestic rates to keep relative strength near current levels and Bunds to stay weak; Pekao says PLN rally hit range floors, break below 4.20/EUR needs more capital; no domestic data this week, MPC meets 13-14 Jan.

Erste/Santander Codziennik 5 Jan: Dec flash CPI 2.4% y/y was 0.1pp below its forecast and Bloomberg consensus, core est. 2.8%; CPI may dip below 2% and core below 2.5% early 2026; expects MPC hold for a while, then cuts in March and May; FRA 5-8bp lower than before Dec flash CPI.
facts.time_basis: Erste upload time from file URL (PDF created earlier)

facts.text: PAP close 5 Jan 15:07: EURPLN 4.2157, OK0128 3.79%, PS0131 4.56%, DS1035 5.16% (yields -1bp on day).
Defence minister Kosiniak-Kamysz (on X): Armed Forces Support Fund (FWSZ) spent PLN 51.4bn in 2025, over twice 2023.
facts.time_basis: PAP summary timestamp = upper bound of first publication

facts.text: 6 Jan was a Polish market holiday (Epiphany); German flash HICP Dec 1.8% y/y vs 2.0% consensus (Nov 2.3%), PL bonds reacted on 7 Jan.
PKO Dziennik 7 Jan: base case is continued sideways local trends in SPW at least until US payrolls on Fri 9 Jan; EURPLN 4.20-4.22.

Erste/Santander 7 Jan: FWSZ 2025 spending of PLN 51.4bn was ~20bn below plan (67% of initial budget plan), so 2025 defence spending was likely at least 0.5pp of GDP below the planned 4.7% of GDP, possibly shifting the spending impulse into 2026.
facts.time_basis: Erste upload time from file URL (PDF created earlier)

facts.text: PAP morning: PKO says that after large SPW moves and repricing of NBP cuts in late Dec, sideways trends in POLGBs this week remain its scenario; empty domestic calendar.
GUS: median gross wage in national economy July 2025 PLN 7,246.64 (+9.1% y/y vs 9.7% in June).
NBP: official reserve assets rose to EUR 231.02bn in Dec from 229.07bn in Nov.

MoF announced (on Wed 7 Jan) the 9 Jan sale auction: PLN 8-12bn in OK0128, PS0130, WZ0930, PS0131, NZ0331 (new), DS1033 and DS1035 (monthly plan had 7-12bn); exact release time not found, cited by PAP at 16:51.
facts.time_basis: upper bound (first dated mention); exact release time not found

facts.text: PKO strategist M. Budzicki (PAP): 2Y POLGB fell below 3.75% and 10Y to ~5.10%, levels he expected only at end-Q1; derivatives price NBP ref rate at 3.25% by mid-2026; Friday's 8-12bn auction limits room for further falls. Close 16:37: OK0128 3.71, PS0131 4.50, DS1035 5.11.
Deutsche Bank Polska weekly 7 Jan (A. Krzesniak): estimates core CPI rose to 2.8% y/y in Dec, an argument for a hold; expects MPC to keep ref rate at 4.00% next week.

KPO: PM decision replaced mandatory social contributions on civil contracts with PIP reform as a KPO milestone; deputy minister J. Szyszko expects very difficult talks with the EC; govt spokesman says govt will talk to EC.
facts.time_basis: PAP summary timestamp = upper bound of first publication

facts.text: FinMin Domanski (to PAP): revenue loss from the presidential vetoes of higher alcohol excise and sugar fee will not require amending the 2026 budget; govt stayed within the 2025 deficit limit.
facts.time_basis: PAP summary timestamp = upper bound of first publication

facts.text: PKO Dziennik 8 Jan: SPW yields fell 2-4bp on 7 Jan; 2Y tested ~3.70%, 5Y 4.50%, 10Y 5.10%, all near local supports; with the 8-12bn MoF auction on Fri, expects at least a halt to yield declines.
Monitor Sadowy i Gospodarczy: Nov 2025 25bp cut passed 9-1, only J. Tyrowicz against.
MPC member J. Tyrowicz (LinkedIn): for the first time in this inflation episode CPI may stay durably near target, though services inflation remains high ('one foot in fire, one in ice').

Millennium daily 8 Jan: FRA/IRS fell ~20bp in the past month and the bond curve shifted down 5-30bp after the Dec cut; 10Y PL 5.17% at end of first week of Jan; MoF continues prefinancing record 2026 gross needs.
Erste/Santander 8 Jan: POLGB yields fell 5-9bp on 7 Jan, more at the short end, curve steepened 4bp; IRS/FRA fell only ~1bp.
facts.time_basis: Erste upload time from file URL (PDF created earlier)

facts.text: GUS: housing prices Q3 2025 +4.0% y/y, +0.9% q/q.

MPC member I. Dabrowski (Bloomberg interview, 8 Jan): 50% chance of a cut at the 13-14 Jan meeting after the low Dec CPI, though he personally leans to a pause; sees room for another 50bp of cuts by mid-2026; does not fully exclude a hike this year given geopolitics. Exact Bloomberg time not found; first dated mention DB Polska daily created 11:02 CET.
facts.time_basis: upper bound (first dated mention); exact release time not found

facts.text: Eurostat: Poland unemployment Nov 3.2% s.a., unchanged.
European Commission: Poland ESI Dec 100.0 (Nov 98.9); consumer inflation expectations index rose to 35.3 from 27.9.
NBP website: MPC rejected in Nov Tyrowicz's motion for a 125bp hike (Oct 100bp, Sep 75bp, Jul 50bp motions also rejected).
MoF mandated BNP Paribas, Commerzbank, Deutsche Bank and ING as bookrunners for a EUR benchmark issue.
facts.time_basis: upper bound (first dated mention); exact release time not found

facts.text: ING's M. Sutowicz (PAP): curve largely waiting for next week's MPC; no change expected but cut risk non-zero after Dec CPI surprise and Dabrowski's 50% comment. Close 16:44: OK0128 3.71, PS0131 4.51, DS1035 5.12.
BGK announced its 12 Jan sale auction for the COVID-19 Response Fund: FPC0229, FPC0231, FPC0332, FPC0235, minimum supply PLN 1.0bn.
facts.time_basis: PAP summary timestamp = upper bound of first publication

facts.text: ING economists: risk of losing KPO money over the rejected PIP reform milestone is overstated, about EUR 0.2bn in a no-deal scenario (not base case).

facts.text: MoF priced on 8 Jan EUR 3.25bn: EUR 2bn 5Y due 15 Jan 2031, coupon 2.875%, yield 2.964% (MS+43bp) and EUR 1.25bn 10Y due 15 Jun 2036, coupon 3.625%, yield 3.739% (MS+83bp); books over EUR 12bn. Page dated 08.01.2026 (time not stated; Erste 9 Jan morning: 'yesterday').
Tyrowicz (LinkedIn): core inflation should not entrench near 3% but keep easing toward 2%; disinflation from cheap Chinese imports to last until Apr/May.
GUS quarterly non-financial accounts: general government deficit Q3 2025 PLN 58.431bn.
Erste/Santander 9 Jan: POLGB yields +1-2bp and IRS/FRA +2-5bp on 8 Jan; expects core inflation trend to keep falling but slowly.

facts.text: Millennium daily 9 Jan: dovish MPC comments set against large debt issuance may widen asset-swap spreads; swaps +3-5bp on 8 Jan; 10Y closed 5.14%.
PAP morning: BGK sees EURPLN in slow downtrend; PKO expects further consolidation in domestic rates and no durable break of 4.20% on UST10Y.
Deputy FinMin Neneman: presidential vetoes cost budget ~PLN 1.8bn in 2026 and 2.8bn in 2027 (alcohol excise) and NFZ ~855m (sugar fee).
Eurostat: Poland retail sales Nov +2.1% y/y.
MRPiPS flash: registered unemployment Dec 5.7% (Nov 5.6%).
MoF: prefinancing of 2026 state budget borrowing needs at end-2025 was about 21% (final after year close).
MoF: budget account balance end-Dec ~PLN 133.8bn (earlier estimate 143bn; end-Nov 142.3bn).

DM mBanku's R. Sadoch (PAP): long-end POLGB yields stable, slight decline at the 2Y end as market expects further cuts; US NFP Dec +50k vs 70k expected, unemployment 4.4%. Close 16:43: OK0128 3.70, PS0131 4.50, DS1035 5.11.

facts.text: MoF monthly debt report: 2026 redemptions PLN 215.9bn (wholesale 104.0, retail 53.5, T-bills 28.4, foreign 30.0); public liquidity consolidation 130.5bn; average maturity domestic 4.18y, total 5.75y; MoF says 179.7bn will flow from the budget to the market in 2026.

facts.text: Sejm adopted 10 Senate amendments to the 2026 budget act, ending its work; President has 7 days to sign or send it to the Constitutional Tribunal (no veto right on budget). Deficit cap PLN 271.7bn.
facts.time_basis: PAP summary timestamp = upper bound of first publication

facts.text: KPO/PIP: deputy minister Szyszko says a unilateral exit from the milestone could cost 'over a dozen' PLN bn; ING's L. Kasek sees cost no more than EUR 200-300m; PM Tusk promises a quick corrected PIP draft acceptable to the EU.
facts.time_basis: PAP summary timestamp = upper bound of first publication

facts.text: PAP week-ahead: Santander expects hold and wait-and-see until March (cut probability up after Dec CPI); Goldman Sachs one of few expecting a Jan cut; new member Zarzecki attends first meeting; Santander sees no reason for Dec CPI revision, core ~2.8%; MoF T-bills 36W PLN 2-4bn on 16 Jan.

PKO Dziennik 12 Jan: MPC outcome uncertain to the end; Dabrowski signals even odds; Dec CPI below target, lower food and commodity prices and URE tariffs pushed 2026 inflation forecasts below target, adding room for quick cuts; a cut could extend SPW yield declines.

Credit Agricole MAKROmapa 12 Jan: last week IRS 2Y +4bp to 3.58, 5Y +3bp to 3.78, 10Y flat at 4.19; expects Jan hold (in line with consensus, neutral for POLGBs) and a final 25bp cut in Q1 2026; sees risk of a cut this week.

Millennium daily 12 Jan: NZ0331 was the first 5Y POLSTR bond sold (1.255bn vs 2.07bn demand), MoF has funded ~23% of record ~PLN 690bn 2026 needs; BGK auction may reduce demand for SPW; a hold would push FRA/IRS slightly higher.
PAP morning: PKO says a cut on Wed is not fully priced and would likely trigger further yield declines; Millennium sees Sentix/EUR supporting PLN.
MoF: after the 9 Jan auction, additional sale and EUR issue, 2026 gross borrowing needs are ~26% financed (per budget act).
Millennium weekly 12 Jan: IRS downtrend since Oct may see a further upward correction as next cut likely only in March; 10Y may stay near 5.15% with small upside to 5.20%; EURPLN 4.20-4.215.

Erste/Santander 12 Jan: 4Q-rolling GG deficit after Q3 PLN 267.1bn = 7.0% of GDP; 2025 notified 271bn (7.0%) needs Q4 deficit <=124bn; 2026 budget: deficit 271.7bn, revenue 647.2bn; expects stable debt market this week (no NBP cut, geopolitics).

BGK sold FPC0229, FPC0231, FPC0332, FPC0235 for PLN 3.734bn vs demand 7.05bn at the 12 Jan COVID-fund auction.

BGK sold a further PLN 709m of FPC bonds in the additional sale on 12 Jan (total ~4.4bn).

PKO Dziennik 13 Jan: SPW yields +1/+2bp on 12 Jan with selling pressure late; expects SPW and EURPLN to stabilise until the MPC decision.
Erste/Santander 13 Jan: POLGB yields +1-3bp on 12 Jan but still 2-8bp lower w/w; IRS +3-5bp and FRA +6-7bp w/w, a correction of earlier falls; expects MPC hold.

facts.text: Millennium daily 13 Jan: expects no rate change on 14 Jan, which could push short FRA and IRS slightly higher; good C/A data may support PLN.
BIEC Future Inflation Index fell 0.4pt in Jan; most components point to lower inflation.
PAP morning: BGK says most expect no cut and BoP data matter little for SPW; PAP consensus for Nov C/A +EUR 500m, exports +1.8% y/y, imports +0.8%.
MoF: retail savings bond sales Dec PLN 5.35bn (Nov 5.1bn); full-year 2025 PLN 74.9bn, second-best ever after 82.6bn in 2024.
Deutsche Bank Polska weekly 13 Jan: expects hold at 4.00% with ~15% risk of a 25bp cut; Dec final CPI forecast 0.0% m/m, 2.4% y/y, core 2.8% (same as Bloomberg consensus).

MNI NBP preview: majority of sell-side expect hold (BGK, BOS, Credit Agricole, JPMorgan, Millennium, Pekao, Santander, SocGen, Bank Pocztowy); Goldman forecasts a 25bp cut, PKO sees a cut on the cards, ING 35% probability; market prices terminal ~3.50%; new member Zarzecki said (wPolsce24, date not given) target reached and MPC must think whether to take more risk.
NBP: Nov current account deficit EUR 460m vs consensus surplus 500m; exports +2.7% y/y (cons 1.8%), imports +3.1% (cons 0.8%); 12M C/A deficit 0.7% of GDP (Erste).
NBP: gold was 27.5% of reserves at end-Nov, 543.4 tonnes.

facts.text: PAP close 13 Jan 16:26: OK0128 3.66, PS0131 4.48, DS1035 5.09 (yields down from morning); US CPI Dec 2.7% y/y in line, core 2.6% vs 2.7% expected; ING says BoP has little impact on PLN.
2026 budget act reached the President's Chancellery on 13 Jan (Bogucki on X).
facts.time_basis: PAP summary timestamp = upper bound of first publication

facts.text: Investors TFI (J. Niedzielewski): POLGBs have no room for significant yield declines, but long bonds can still give decent real returns at stable yields.
facts.time_basis: PAP summary timestamp = upper bound of first publication

facts.text: ING Think preview 13 Jan (A. Antoniak): pause is baseline but 35% probability of a cut; expects three 25bp cuts in 2026, terminal 3.25% with downside risks; CPI below 2.5% target most of 2026.

PKO Dziennik 14 Jan: MPC outcome highly uncertain; PKO gives more weight to a 25bp cut (Dec CPI below target, lower food and commodity prices, URE tariffs), while most economists expect a hold; a cut would extend SPW yield declines.
Erste/Santander 14 Jan: POLGB yields fell 3-4bp across the curve on 13 Jan, 'rather unexpectedly'; market rates flat; expects hold, which could lift market rates slightly.
facts.time_basis: Erste upload time from file URL (PDF created earlier)

facts.text: Millennium daily 14 Jan: expects no change; a hold could push FRA/IRS slightly higher; 10Y closed ~5.10% on 13 Jan.
PAP morning: PKO says a cut would surprise and drive further yield falls; BGK sees limited risk of an MPC surprise; Pekao keeps 4.00% base case, noting 10Y back near 5.125%.
MPC (13-14 Jan) held all rates: reference 4.00%, lombard 4.50%, deposit 3.50%, rediscount 4.05%, discount 4.10%, in line with consensus; statement at 16:00; Glapinski press conference 15 Jan 15:00.
After the decision PLN slightly weaker near 4.21/EUR and 2Y/5Y yields slightly up; 14:47: EURPLN 4.2128, OK0128 3.69, PS0131 4.51, DS1035 5.10.

MPC statement: further decisions depend on incoming information on inflation and activity prospects, NBP may intervene in FX; risks are fiscal policy, 'expected' demand recovery, wages and the foreign macro situation incl. commodity prices (energy prices dropped from the list); Q4 GDP growth likely close to Q3 (3.8%); Dec core inflation estimated close to Nov (2.7%).
MoF public debt director K. Czarnecki (to Bloomberg): after the EUR deal MoF considers JPY, CHF and USD issues in early 2026, watching the USD market after the probe into the Fed chair.
facts.time_basis: upper bound (first dated mention); exact release time not found

facts.text: Post-decision views (PAP): mBank says statement adds little; Erste's J. Cery expects 25bp in March and another in Q2 to 3.5%, noting market-implied 3.50-3.25%; PKO expects March cut and 3.50% in two quick steps with Q1 CPI ~2%; Bank Pocztowy's M. Kurtek sees two cuts (50bp) in March/April.

ING (Antoniak, Benecki, Kasek) 14 Jan: hold no surprise; next cut likely March with the new projection, at least three cuts in 2026 to 3.25%; dropping energy from risks implies a markedly lower March CPI path.
